entries.title: Shared contract source of truth
entries.nextAction: Mirror-parity gap CLOSED by PR #1104; the generated-mirror + sync-script half remains
entries.notes: The audit decided this rather than leaving it open: there is no root package.json and no workspace tooling, the functions tsconfig scopes rootDir and include to src, and firebase deploy zips only the functions directory - so a genuine shared module means new workspace tooling plus deploy-packaging risk, against a Functions pipeline that is manual and has no CI gate. Generated mirror plus parity CI carries zero deploy risk and is repo-native. GAP FOUND: governedBusinessRoles.ts and shadowParityHarness.ts are mirrored with NO cross-file parity test - and governedBusinessRoles.ts is exactly the file PR #1100 would have to change in lockstep. UPDATE: the parity-coverage half is done (PR #1104) - governedBusinessRoles.ts and shadowParityHarness.ts are now enforced, and the CI path filter now includes field-ops-app-vite/src/access/** so a client-only edit actually triggers the guard. Remaining: single authored source plus generated mirror, so humans and agents stop hand-maintaining two copies at all.

entries.title: Bounded-read remediation across list-exempt surfaces
